Two different liquids of the same mass are kept in two identical vessels which are placed in a freezer that extracts heat from them at the same rate causing each liquid to transform into a solid. The schematic ﬁgure below shows the temperature \(T\) versus time \(t\) plot for the two materials. 1.\(C_{L_1}>C_{L_2}~\text{and }U_1<U_2\)
2.\(C_{L_2}>C_{L_1}~\text{and }U_1<U_2\)
3.\(C_{L_1}<C_{L_2}~\text{and }U_1>U_2\)
